Audience.description: Target audience access control setting for an endpoint (EP-14).

oneOf.description: Restricted to explicitly listed projects within the organization.
Accessible to any authenticated member or service account of the organization.
Accessible publicly without authentication under the synthetic public role grant.

Audit.description: Whether an Endpoint keeps an audit trail of the writes through it (ADR-N-054 2.8, DM-136).

oneOf.description: The type's history rule alone decides which rows exist (the owner's default).
A write that changes a value is kept as a version row, even where the type records no history; an exact repeat stores nothing.

Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

component.description: The digest of a `wasm` App's server component, taken from the checked bundle and stored by it in the object store; what the WASM host loads and checks (AP-151).

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

Caching.description: HTTP caching configuration for endpoint responses.

Catalog.description: The catalogue description of one Endpoint (EP-78).

applicableLegislation.description: ELI IRIs of the laws that apply: `dcatap:applicableLegislation`.

attribution.description: The words the attribution duty asks for, per language: `dct:rights`.

contactPoint.description: Where questions about it go: `dcat:contactPoint`, a role address (EP-80).

frequency.description: How often the data changes, from the EU frequency table: `dct:accrualPeriodicity`.

harvest.description: Whether the installation's and the project's feeds list the record (EP-139, EP-84, EP-127). `false` for a door over data other datasets already publish, such as a whole space split into one dataset per type: its own record stays, a harvester never takes the same data twice. Unset is `true`.

license.description: The licence, from the EU licence table: `dct:license`.

personalData.description: Whether the data holds personal data, as the publisher states it; never read from the data. Only the national profiles carry it: `leg:personalDataContainmentType` and `pu:osobní-údaje` (API/08 section 5).

pipelineRef.description: The Pipeline of this project that fills the space: `prov:wasGeneratedBy`.

source.description: The original open datasets the data comes from: `dct:source`.

visualizations.description: Charts on the dataset, Vega-Lite 5 or Vega 5 over the Endpoint's own sources, published as CKAN `jc_visualization` views (ADR-N-053, EP-130); validated by the Endpoint, which knows what it serves.

CkanPublication.description: Publication of one Endpoint as one CKAN dataset (EP-62…EP-65).

license.description: The CKAN licence id the organization chose, such as `cc-by` for CC-BY 4.0. Used when the Endpoint's DCAT-AP record names no `dct:license`, which is the one term the record does not carry (EP-62, EP-63).

name.description: The CKAN dataset name; the Endpoint's own name when absent.

organization.description: The CKAN organization slug; the instance's default when absent.

ContactPoint.description: The contact point of a dataset, a `vcard:Kind`.

email.description: A role address, never a person's own (EP-80): `vcard:hasEmail`.

Creates.description: How an Endpoint takes new entities from callers who do not choose their ids: a public form (EP-97).

embedOrigins.description: The sites that may frame the form's page `/f/{slug}`, each an `https` origin exactly as a browser names it (`https://www.example.org`, an optional non-default port, no path, no wildcard), at most 20. The Portal sends them in that page's `frame-ancestors` and nowhere else; empty, only the Portal frames the form (EP-101).

mintIds.description: The gateway replaces the id a create names with one it mints, `urn:ngsi-ld:{Type}:{uuid}`, so a caller can neither pick nor overwrite one.

perDay.description: At most this many creates through the Endpoint per UTC day, 1..=10000; past it the gateway answers 429 with `Retry-After` until midnight UTC.

DataTheme.description: A theme of the EU data-theme table.

oneOf.description: Justice, legal system and public safety.

DateMode.description: How a date field reads its value.

oneOf.description: As the value is: a date stays a date, a date-time a date-time.

Deprecation.description: A breaking change of a public Endpoint, announced ahead (EP-146).

link.description: A public `https` page about the change and its replacement.

representations.description: Only these surfaces are deprecated; empty, the whole Endpoint.

since.description: The day the deprecation was announced, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

sunset.description: The earliest day the deprecated part may stop answering, at least 90 days after `since`.

Display.description: An override of the model's display order for one type: an Endpoint's `spec.display` entry or a visualization's `fields` (EP-135). Either list empty leaves that part to the model.

fields.description: The slots shown, in this order; the rest are not shown.

summary.description: The key attributes, in place of the model's `summary` annotations.

EndpointRole.description: One role an Endpoint gives the callers it admits who match a subject (AP-96, AP-97).

name.description: The role's name, `[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}`; the caller holds [`endpoint_role`] of it.

subjects.description: Who holds it: `user` by e-mail, `group` by name, never a wildcard.

EndpointSlug.description: Cryptographically random endpoint slug with at least 128 bits of entropy (lowercase RFC 4648 base32 without padding, >=26 chars, EP-02)

allowedProjects.description: Whitelist of project slugs permitted when audience is `project-list` (EP-14, EP-15).

audit.description: `changes`: every write through this Endpoint that changes a value is kept as a version with its provenance, whatever the type's history rule (ADR-N-054 2.8, DM-136).

callerRole.description: Every caller this Endpoint admits holds the role [`endpoint_role`] names for it, on requests through this Endpoint alone (AP-96, AP-97). The App reconciler sets it, so an App's grants never reach another surface of the space.

catalog.description: What a DCAT-AP catalogue needs beyond the distributions: publisher, contact, licence, themes, coverage, frequency and provenance (EP-78, EP-79).

creates.description: How the Endpoint takes new entities: minted ids and a daily cap (EP-97).

deprecation.description: A breaking change announced ahead: the gateway answers with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers until the deprecated part is removed (EP-146, EP-147).

disabledRepresentations.description: Representations an Endpoint without `enabledRepresentations` does not serve (EP-104).

display.description: Per entity type, the slots this Endpoint's tables, popups and CKAN columns show and its key attributes, reordering and narrowing the model's display order (EP-135, DM-98).

enabledRepresentations.description: The representations this Endpoint serves, listed (EP-05). Omitted: every one but `sta`, less `disabledRepresentations` (EP-104); see [`EndpointSpec::served_representations`].

mcp.description: `false` turns the Endpoint's MCP instance off. Every Endpoint serves `mcp` without listing it, public or internal, gated by its own Policy (EP-24, T-2901); see [`EndpointSpec::served_representations`].

policyRef.description: Optional NGSI-LD Policy URN attached to this endpoint; means `policyRefs: [it]`.

policyRefs.description: The Policies this Endpoint evaluates, each a Policy URN of its space (ADR-N-057 decision 2). Never set beside `policyRef` and never empty; read both through [`EndpointSpec::policy_refs`].

projection.description: Optional publication narrowing applied to every representation (EP-61).

projectionRef.description: The named subset of the space's model this Endpoint reads (MP-02): a `ModelProjection` of the same space, intersected with the caller's grants by the gateway, so it narrows and never widens.

publish.description: Where this Endpoint is published beside its own surface: an open-data catalogue so far (EP-62).

representations.description: The mappings of the domain-standard representations, `ical` first (EP-125, API/02 §8b).

roles.description: Roles a caller this Endpoint admits holds when a subject matches them, on requests through it alone (AP-96, AP-97).

slug.description: Unguessable opaque slug with >= 128 bits of entropy (EP-02).

viewMappingRef.description:
A `Mapping` whose target model this Endpoint serves instead of the space's own (EP-54, DM-51).

The gateway translates every entity through the Mapping's compiled IR and rewrites `attrs`, `q` and `geoQ` back through its inverse. An Endpoint that carries one is read only: a mapping is invertible per slot, not per entity, so a write in the target model has no source entity to reconstruct.

filter.description: What narrows the view for this output; it never widens it.

lang.description: The feed's language when the request names none.

limit.description: The default page size, 1 to 200 (50 when left out).

name.description: A slug `[a-z0-9-]`, 1 to 63, unique on the Endpoint: the URL segment after `feed/v1/`.

sort.description: The order: `updated`, newest first, the only one.

sources.description: The model classes the feed lists, each with its roles.

version.description: The contract version, 1 when left out.

anyOf.description: The first of several with a value.

FeedPaths.description: One attribute path, or a list of them: the first with a value wins.

FeedPreset.description: A named starting mapping (API/02 §8b, the presets table).

FeedSort.description: The order of a feed's entries.

FeedSource.description: One model class of an output.

mapping.description: Roles on top of the preset, or the whole mapping without one.

FieldRemap.description: The object form of a [`FieldSource`] (API/02 §8b): exactly one of `attribute`, `firstOf`, `join` and `constant`, and the remaps the field allows.

attribute.description: An attribute, or a dotted path into its value (`address.addressLocality`).

date.description: How a date field reads its value.

default.description: The calendar value of a source value `map` does not name.

endInclusive.description: The source names the last day, so DTEND is the day after.

firstOf.description: The first of these attributes that has a value.

join.description: The values of these attributes that have one, joined by `separator`.

language.description: Which text of a LanguageProperty: a two-letter code or `first` (the default).

timezone.description: The IANA zone of a floating time; default `Europe/Bratislava`.

FieldSource.description: A field's source: an attribute name, or an object with one source and its remaps.

FileLimits.description:
How much of a `file.*` representation one download may return (EP-44).

The gateway pages through the broker and stops at the first row that would cross either bound, so a caller gets a refusal rather than a file that is silently short. An absent field leaves the gateway's own ceiling in charge.

maxFileBytes.description: Bytes a single download may return.

maxFileRows.description: Rows a single download may return.

Frequency.description: An update frequency of the EU frequency table.

IcalMapping.description: One source of an [`IcalOutput`] (`spec.representations.ical[].sources[]`), and the deprecated single mapping object.

mapping.description: Fields that replace the preset's, or the whole mapping when no preset is named.

preset.description: The preset the mapping starts from; with no `mapping` either, `sdm-event`.

type.description: The NGSI-LD type the feed maps.

version.description: The contract version (API/11 EP-152); `1` when absent, the one version the broker reads.

IcalOutput.description: One named calendar of `spec.representations.ical` (API/11 EP-159), served at `/ical/v1/{name}.ics`.

description.description: The calendar's description per language tag.

filter.description: A query that narrows the view for this calendar, never widens it.

lang.description: The language tag (BCP 47) a LanguageProperty is read in when a field names none.

limit.description: At most this many Events, 1 to 10000.

name.description: The URL slug: lowercase letters, digits and `-`, 1 to 40, unique on the Endpoint.

sort.description: `start` or `-start`: the order the first `limit` Events are kept in.

sources.description: The model classes the calendar maps, each with its preset or mapping; 1 to 10.

timezone.description: The IANA zone a time without offset is read in; default `Europe/Bratislava`.

title.description: The calendar's title per language tag (`NAME`, `X-WR-CALNAME`).

version.description: The contract version (API/11 EP-152); `1` when absent.

Licence.description: A licence of the EU licence table whose duties are known (EP-79).

oneOf.description: Open Data Commons Open Database Licence.
Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

OutputFilter.description: An output's NGSI-LD query on top of the view (TS 104 175 6.4.3.2): `q` and `scopeQ` are AND-ed with a caller's, and a geo-query here cannot be replaced by one.

PersonalData.description: The publisher's statement about personal data in a dataset (API/08 section 5).

oneOf.description: The data holds no personal data.
Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

Projection.description:
What this Endpoint never serves, whatever the Policy set allows (EP-61).

A publication decision, not an authorization one: the gateway intersects this list with the caller's policy projection, so an Endpoint can subtract from a grant and never add to it. The same space can therefore be published twice with different amounts of detail without writing a second Policy, and because the subtraction happens where every representation reads its entities, a hidden attribute is missing from the CSV, the GeoJSON, the MCP tool result and the schema surface alike (EP-06, EP-07, EP-47).

hiddenAttributes.description: Attribute names this endpoint removes from every representation.

Publication.description: Where an Endpoint is published beside its own surface (EP-62).

Publisher.description: The publisher of a dataset, a `foaf:Agent`.

uri.description: The publisher's own IRI, its web site or registry entry.

RateLimits.description: Token-bucket rate limiting configuration per endpoint (EP-20).

burst.description: Optional maximum burst capacity above steady rate.

anyOf.description: Typed reference with kind, name, and optional namespace.

Ref.description: Reference to another resource, either bare name or typed reference (MF-07).

Representation.description:
Supported representation formats served under an endpoint (EP-05, Architecture/04).

Note: `schema` (EP-46) and `access` (EP-55) are not variants: they are unconditional surfaces on every endpoint and cannot be toggled off. `file.csv` is the one file an Endpoint publishes; the names of the removed files are refused by name ([`REMOVED_REPRESENTATIONS`]).

oneOf.description: Direct Model Context Protocol streamable HTTP interface (`/mcp`).
Flat tabular CSV (`/file.csv`), the one file an Endpoint publishes.
OGC API - Features Part 1 collections and items (`/ogc/features/`).
SensorThings API v1.1 read projection (`/sta/v1.1/`); served only where listed (EP-104), and only on a space whose model has a numeric attribute with a unit (EP-125).
OData v4 service of the Endpoint's view (`/odata/v4/`, EP-104).
iCalendar (RFC 5545) feed of the view's entities (`/ical/v1/`); served only where listed, through the mapping `spec.representations.ical` checked against the space's model (EP-125).
Atom, RSS 2.0 and JSON Feed of the view's entities (`/feed/v1/{name}/`); served exactly where `spec.representations.feed` lists an output, never through `enabledRepresentations` (EP-150, EP-151).

Representations.description: `spec.representations`: the mappings of the domain-standard representations (EP-125).

feed.description: The feed outputs (Atom, RSS 2.0, JSON Feed); none means no feed (EP-150, EP-151).

ical.description: The iCalendar outputs (API/11 EP-159); none means no calendar is served. The single mapping object of version 1 loads as one output named `events` (deprecated).

widget.description: The catalogue widget's defaults per class: the map's geometry, colour, popup and clustering (API/11 EP-163). Never read by the broker.

Source.description: One original dataset the data comes from, itself a `dcat:Dataset`.

description.description: Its description per language; DCAT-AP requires one of every dataset it names.

title.description: Its title per language; DCAT-AP requires one of every dataset it names.

url.description: Its IRI, the page or API of the original.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

shard.description: The shard of the WASM host a `wasm` App runs on, recorded at its first publish and kept; the edge's route to the App's server is rendered from it (AP-149).

Subject.description: One human or group a binding names; exactly one of `user`, `group` (PF-49).

group.description: A group: a `Group` manifest of the organization unless `source` says otherwise (PF-64).

source.description: Who owns `group`'s members: absent for a `Group` manifest, `provider` for a group the identity provider owns, which the reconciler never manages. Only a `RoleBinding` subject carries it, and only with `group` (PF-63, PF-64).

user.description: The person's Keycloak user id, the `sub` of their token: a lower-case UUID, never an e-mail or a username (PF-126); or a client's own `service-account-<client>` user.

SubjectSource.description: Who owns the members of a subject's group (PF-64).

oneOf.description: A group of the identity provider, such as the realm's default group; no `Group` manifest declares it and the reconciler never creates, edits or prunes it (PF-63).

Temporal.description: The period a dataset covers; either end may be open.

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

namespace.description: Target resource namespace (defaults to caller namespace if omitted).

Urn.description: NGSI-LD entity URN (ADR-N-041, PF-43): urn:ngsi-ld:{Type}:{id}; the prefixed shape urn:ngsi-ld:{Type}:{orgDomain}:{space}:{localId} is optional

data.description: Which of the Endpoint's own sources fills the spec's dataset `source`.

name.description: Unique on the Endpoint, a DNS label: the CKAN view is found again by it.

spec.description: The Vega-Lite 5 or Vega 5 specification; it reads `{"data": {"name": "source"}}`.

VisualizationData.description: The Endpoint source a visualization reads, never a URL (ADR-N-053 §2.2).

oneOf.description: The Endpoint's `file.csv` of one entity type.
The items of one OGC API Features collection.

entitySet.description: The entity set, the entity type.

oneOf.description: NGSI-LD Query Temporal Evolution of Entities over the last `last`.

aggrPeriod.description: The NGSI-LD aggregation period, an ISO 8601 duration.

attrs.description: The attributes whose history is read.

last.description: An ISO 8601 duration of at most `P31D`.

description.description: The output's description per language tag.

name.description: A slug: lowercase letters, digits and `-`, 1 to 40, unique on the Endpoint.

sources.description: The model classes it sets defaults for; 1 to 10, each class once.

title.description: The output's title per language tag.

WidgetRoles.description: The map roles of a class; an absent role keeps the widget's default (EP-161).

colour.description: The enum or boolean attribute the markers are coloured and the legend is drawn by.

geometry.description: The GeoProperty drawn (`location`, `operationSpace` or a model GeoProperty).

popup.description: The attributes the popup shows, in order; 1 to 10.

WidgetSource.description: One class of a [`WidgetOutput`] and its map defaults.

cluster.description: Whether markers cluster; absent: the widget's own rule (above 200 in view, EP-161).

mapping.description: The roles: which attribute the map reads for each.

table.description: Where the table starts; absent: the model's `view_*` annotations (EP-164).

type.description: The model class, by its local name (`Event`).

columns.description: The columns shown, in order; 1 to 30, each once.

orderBy.description: The default order: one attribute, `;desc` for descending (`startDate`, `name;desc`).

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.
